item.title: Picasso etching stolen in 2018 found in vacant apartment after landlord’s discovery
item.description: A Picasso etching stolen from Milwaukee art gallery in 2018 has been recovered after a landlord found it in a dust-covered apartment, reviving a six-year-old theft investigation.

item.title: Hawaii Faces Rare Hurricane Strike Threatening Flooding Rain
item.description: Tropical Storm Lala is threatening more than two feet of rain as it moves toward Hawaii’s Big Island and could become the first hurricane to hit the island in more than 100 years.

item.title: BBC seeks Trump Jr, Ivanka Trump and Kushner testimony in $10 billion defamation case
item.description: The BBC is seeking court approval to subpoena Donald Trump Jr, Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner in President Trump’s $10 billion defamation lawsuit over the broadcaster’s editing of his 6 January speech.

item.title: Spider-Man Beyond the Spider-Verse trailer leaks online; writer Chris Miller reacts to unfinished footage
item.description: The trailer for Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse has reportedly leaked online ahead of its 2027 release, prompting co-writer Chris Miller to distance himself from the unfinished footage.

item.description: Bihar CM expressed grief over the incident and directed the concerned officials to provide an ex gratia of ₹4 lakh each to the kin of the deceased.

item.description: The trend is particularly popular among students, working professionals and content creators looking to create personalised profile pictures, posters and digital greetings.

item.title: Over 1 million eggs recalled in US over possible contamination – check your fridge
item.description: Nearly 1.6 million dozen eggs recalled over possible Salmonella contamination have been linked to a multistate outbreak that has sickened 98 people and hospitalised 26, according to health authorities.&nbsp;

item.title: I-Day: Delhi Police honoured with 17 medals, including 2 President's Medals
item.description: Among the PSM awardees is Additional Commissioner of Police Dinesh Kumar Gupta, a 2010-batch IPS officer, who has held several key operational and specialised assignments in Delhi Police.

item.description: India and Russia are holding talks to deepen cooperation on the Northern Sea Route, the MEA said. Moscow is developing the Arctic corridor as a major Europe-Asia trade link, with India exploring connectivity opportunities.

item.title: Coffee, shower, dance, then theft: Varanasi thief’s bizarre break-in before ₹4.71-lakh KTM getaway—here's what happened
item.description: In Varanasi, a man broke into a vehicle showroom and spent nearly four and a half hours indulging in coffee, a shower, and dancing before stealing a KTM motorcycle valued at ₹4.71 lakh, leaving police baffled.

item.title: US Senator Elizabeth Warren asks Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to justify the Trump administration's Yen intervention
item.description: Senator Elizabeth Warren pressed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to explain the Trump administration’s justification for intervening in the yen, extending the senior Democrat’s pattern of scrutinizing the Trump administration’s foreign-exchange policies.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
item.description: US President Donald Trump has asked the Supreme Court to allow construction of a planned White House ballroom to continue, challenging a lower court order that would halt above-ground work.

item.description: Addressing the nation on the eve of India's 80th Independence Day, Murmu described students as the architects of India's future and said safeguarding their present and future required collective efforts.

item.description: The US will soon announce unprecedented economic measures against Iran, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said, intensifying the Trump administration’s effort to force Tehran’s capitulation after almost six months of war.

item.description: The 80th Independence Day celebrations at Red Fort will feature a flag-hoisting by PM Modi, a 21-gun salute, and performances of Vande Mataram and the National Anthem. 2,500 cadets and 5,000 guests are expected to attend.

item.title: Monsoon rains to intensify across east, central and north India as depression forms
item.description: A depression over Jharkhand is likely to trigger very heavy rain in parts of eastern and central India, while the Western Himalayas face a week of heavy rainfall.

item.description: The Supreme Court has halted a ruling by the Madras High Court that invalidated Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay's decision to offer jobs to relatives of Karur stampede victims, which resulted in 41 deaths.&nbsp;

item.title: Delhi weather: Will rain dampen Independence Day festivities tomorrow? Check IMD forecast
item.description: The forecast has been issued ahead of the Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort on August 15, as the weather could affect the morning events.

item.title: Independence Day: Several Delhi roads to remain closed near Red Fort on Aug 15; check alternate routes
item.description: Several roads near the Red Fort will remain closed to general traffic from 4 am to 10 am. Only vehicles carrying valid labels will be allowed on these routes.

item.title: Sicily's Catania Airport shuts down due to Mount Etna eruption; 1,000+ flights canceled
item.description: The closures have caused widespread travel chaos, with about 1,000 flights cancelled and another 350 rerouted to other facilities between Aug. 6 and Aug. 12

item.title: Union health minister JP Nadda admitted to AIIMS Delhi after uneasiness, undergoes coronary angiography
item.description: Union health minister JP Nadda was admitted to AIIMS Delhi after experiencing uneasiness and underwent coronary angiography. He is stable and under observation in the cardiology department.

item.title: Samay Raina gets relief! SC dismisses FIRs against stand-up comedian and 4 others over remarks about disabled persons
item.description: The Supreme Court dismissed FIRs against comedian Samay Raina and others for alleged insensitive remarks concerning persons with disabilities. A three-judge Bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana passed the order.

item.title: Independence Day: 10 numbers that define India’s rise as a developing nation since the ‘stroke of the midnight hour'
item.description: On 15 August, 1947, when India began its journey as an independent nation, it faced enormous challenges - widespread poverty, low literacy, poor health infrastructure, and a largely rural population.
